title: Design of a China Cup
description: This design study explores the balance between form, proportion, and craftsmanship in a traditional China cup. The model highlights the smooth curvature, refined rim, and elegant silhouette that make the object both functional and sculptural.

title: CubeSat Chassis 2×3×4
description: A compact 2×3×4 CubeSat frame engineered in SolidWorks for low-Earth orbit deployment. The design balances structural rigidity with minimal mass, using aluminium alloy profiles sized to standard CubeSat unit (U) specifications.

title: CubeSat Chassis 2×6×4
description: An extended 2×6×4 CubeSat frame designed for increased payload capacity. The elongated bay accommodates additional PCB stacks or sensor arrays while maintaining compatibility with standard dispensers.

title: CubeSat Chassis 4×6
description: A robust 4×6 CubeSat chassis architecture designed for versatile multi-payload missions. The wider cross-section enables side-panel solar array integration and provides additional mounting rails for attitude-determination hardware.
